title: Solving Linear Equations
preview: Equations with variables on both sides, multi-step equations, determining the number of solutions, and writing and solving two-step inequalities.
description: Students solve and write multi-step linear equations from real setups, including equations with the variable on both sides, decide whether an equation has one, no, or infinitely many solutions, and write, solve, and graph two-step inequalities.

sections.label: 3-1 Solve Equations with Variables on Both Sides
sections.description: Solve equations with the variable on both sides; collect like terms across the equals sign.

sections.label: 3-2 Write and Solve Equations with Variables on Each Side
sections.description: Write an equation with the variable on both sides from a real context, then solve and interpret it.

sections.label: 3-3 Solve Multi-Step Equations
sections.description: Solve equations that require combining like terms and the distributive property.

sections.label: 3-4 Write and Solve Multi-Step Equations
sections.description: Set up and solve multi-step word problems, including those requiring the distributive property.

sections.label: 3-5 Determine the Number of Solutions
sections.description: Classify a linear equation as having one, no, or infinitely many solutions.

sections.label: 3-6 Write and Solve Two-Step Inequalities
sections.description: Write, solve, and graph two-step inequalities, including reversing the sign when dividing by a negative.

source.name: Plug N Play
source.attribution: Plug N Play. Module organisation aligned to Indiana grade-8 academic standards (linear equations and inequalities, 8.AF.1 / 8.AF.2).
